name: afwaah-tracker
description: AfwaahTracker - claim fingerprinting, source provenance and mutation tracking on Oracle Database

scripts.install-all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,cyan "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,cyan "npm start --prefix server" "npm run preview --prefix client"
